{{Quote|The Knight who referred your son to Dantooine was correct, Madam. Zayne has a marginal proclivity for the Force.|Vandar Tokare, to [[Reiva Carrick]]|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
A '''Jedi Knight''' referred the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zayne Carrick]] to the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> in [[3977 BBY]].<ref name="date">The [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook|''Knights of the Old Republic Handbook'']] states that [[Zayne Carrick]] had just turned five when he was brought to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and that he spent his 19th [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] in the brig. The latter is shown in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|issues 15]] and [[Knights of the Old Republic 17|17]] of [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' series]], both of which take place in [[3963 BBY]]. From that, it can be calculated that Carrick was brought to Dantooine 14 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before being in the brig, which would be in [[3977 BBY]].</ref> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] said that Carrick had "marginal" aptitude for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], an assertion supported by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vandar Tokare]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Knight was mentioned in a flashback in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> and released on [[February 22]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-858/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-2|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #2}}</ref>
